rootCause: 796 Exchange reported that a lookalike address replaced a customer's withdrawal destination. The associated Bitcoin transaction paid 999.9999 BTC to that address. Two later payments totaling 1,000 BTC reached the reported intended destination. A reported flaw in an updated withdrawal submodule allowed destination substitution. Phone and email checks did not distinguish the lookalike address from the intended payee. The precise intrusion and timing of the substitution remain unknown.

Unfortunately, that didn’t stop the incident from happening last night. In the last 24 hours, our security team worked around the clock to trace back the codes and processes.
